answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 1250 Country: United Kingdom Title: If a person buys three house for 150,000 Each and on each house he gets rent of 10,000 a year, is Zakah payable on 30,000 rent income or on full 3 house price 450,000 plus the 30,000 rent income? Question: Salam, If a person buys three house for 150,000 Each and on each house he gets rent of 10,000 a year, is Zakah payable on 30,000 rent income or on full 3 house price 450,000 plus the 30,000 rent income? Answer ID: 1250 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1141=856/H) There is no Zakah (obligatory charity) on the price of the three houses, but Zakah is only on the rent received from the three houses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
